POWER STEERING GEAR BOX ASSEMBLY
TSB Revision
POWER STEERING
37A-29
DISASSEMBLY SERVICE POINTS
<<A>> TIE ROD/TAB WASHER REMOVAL
Unstake the tab washer which secures the tie rod and rack with 
a chisel.
<<B>> RACK SUPPORT COVER REMOVAL
Using special tool MB991204, remove the rack support cover 
from the gear box.
<<C>> OIL SEAL/PINION AND VALVE ASSEMBLY 
REMOVAL
Using a plastic hammer, gently tap the pinion to remove it.
<<D>> SEAL RING REMOVAL
CAUTION
When cutting the seal ring, be careful not to damage the 
pinion and valve assembly or the rack.
Cut the seal ring and remove it from the pinion and valve 
assembly and the rack.
